fieldValues.title: Writer / argument builder
fieldValues.summary: A person working with AI on a structured argument (a specific case of "A person working with AI"), who needs the structure to hold as the text changes.
jobs: Lay out a claim with its premises
Attach sources and counter-claims to a claim
Restructure an argument without losing links
Ask an agent to enrich without rewriting
Publish the argument in a readable form
fieldValues.needs: Structure that survives editing, sources and counter-claims attached, and agents that never write their text.
